All-Purpose Cleaning Method Taught Personally by the CEO of an Air Conditioner Company!

Are you just going to leave the dust and mold accumulated all winter?

Key Summary

1. Remove the filter and remove large dust particles using a non-woven fabric cloth or wet wipes.

2. Wash thoroughly with sodium percarbonate, then rinse with a showerhead.

3. Clean the air vents and frame safely, only within easy reach!

4. Finish by disinfecting with ethanol!
